f.title: Send urgent safety data on the original form with a cover letter explaining the problem and measures
f.statement: The PV responsible person sends the urgent safety data on the form on which the information was delivered to the MAH, with a cover letter stating the problem and justifying the proposed urgent measures. Urgent safety measures are taken when a change in the benefit-risk balance requires significant changes to the product's status: withdrawal from the market; SmPC changes (new contraindication, warning or precaution, dose reduction, restriction of indication); and informing health professionals and patients of the newly identified risk without delay.

f.title: Submit PSURs on request or on the 6-monthly, annual, then 3-yearly cycle
f.statement: The MAH submits PSURs to the Agency at its request or as regular reports. Regular PSURs follow this schedule: twice a year during the first two years after first authorisation, once a year for the next two years, and once every three years for the duration of the authorisation, or when the Agency requires. For medicines authorised in EU Member States, the submission periodicity according to the adopted PSUR birthday schedule is accepted.
f.clause: Član 9 (Dostavljanje periodičnog i redovitog izvješća o sigurnosti lijeka)
f.exceptions: Medicines authorised in EU Member States may follow the EU PSUR birthday schedule.

f.title: Include the minimum PSUR content set by the rulebook
f.statement: A PSUR contains at least: introduction with basic product data; MA status outside BiH; safety actions taken in and outside BiH (dates, reasons, type); changes to safety information (new contraindications, precautions, warnings, ADRs, interactions); sales volume in and outside BiH / patient exposure; individual serious ADR cases from trials, marketing or literature with analysis; new safety information from additional toxicological, preclinical and clinical studies; summary tabulations of other ADRs; an overall safety evaluation with benefit-risk assessment and post-marketing experience versus the SmPC (including new toxic effects, increased frequency of known ADRs, interactions, overdose, abuse and dependence, pregnancy and lactation, long-term use, at-risk groups); other information after the data cut-off; a conclusion on what changes previous experience and which measures are needed and why.
f.clause: Član 10 (Sadržaj periodičnog izvješća o sigurnosti lijeka)
